member.remarks: Any class or struct annotated with this attribute is recognized by the C# compiler as a union type. Union types may support behaviors such as implicit conversions from case types, pattern matching that unwraps the union's contents, and switch exhaustiveness checking.

member.summary: Provides a common interface for accessing the contents of a union type at runtime.
